FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good night only
   B. Thank you
   C. Good morning / hello
   D. Excuse me

2. When practising Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.

3. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

7. When practising Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

10. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. chaise
   B. porte
   C. fenêtre
   D. livre
